local camp, scen = 1, 1
-- Cỡ nút theo đơn vị của TTS; nút to/nhỏ quá thì chỉnh K rồi dựng lại.
local K = 1000

function onLoad(saved)
  if saved and saved ~= "" then
    local s = JSON.decode(saved)
    camp, scen = s.c or 1, s.s or 1
  end
  if not DATA[camp] then camp = 1 end
  if not DATA[camp].scenarios[scen] then scen = 1 end
  draw()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode({c = camp, s = scen}) end

function noop() end

local function button(label, fn, x, z, w, h, size, color)
  self.createButton({label = label, click_function = fn, function_owner = self,
    position = {x, 0.15, z}, width = w * K, height = h * K, font_size = size * K,
    color = color or {0.12, 0.11, 0.10}, font_color = {0.93, 0.89, 0.82}})
end

function draw()
  self.clearButtons()
  local c = DATA[camp]
  local s = c.scenarios[scen]
  button(c.name, "noop", 0, -0.86, 1.6, 0.11, 0.07, {0.05, 0.05, 0.05})
  if #DATA > 1 then
    button("◀", "prevCampaign", -0.88, -0.86, 0.1, 0.1, 0.07)
    button("▶", "nextCampaign", 0.88, -0.86, 0.1, 0.1, 0.07)
  end
  button("◀", "prevScenario", -0.88, -0.68, 0.1, 0.1, 0.07)
  button(s.name, "noop", 0, -0.68, 1.55, 0.1, 0.065, {0.05, 0.05, 0.05})
  button("▶", "nextScenario", 0.88, -0.68, 0.1, 0.1, 0.07)
  local cols = 4
  for i, clip in ipairs(s.clips) do
    local col, row = (i - 1) % cols, math.floor((i - 1) / cols)
    _G["play_" .. i] = function() play(i) end
    button(clip.label, "play_" .. i, -0.69 + col * 0.46, -0.46 + row * 0.18, 0.43, 0.15, 0.06,
      {0.20, 0.10, 0.09})
  end
  button("■  Dừng", "stop", 0, 0.88, 0.6, 0.1, 0.065, {0.35, 0.08, 0.06})
end

function play(i)
  local s = DATA[camp].scenarios[scen]
  local clip = s.clips[i]
  MusicPlayer.setCurrentAudioclip({url = clip.url, title = clip.title})
  broadcastToAll("▶ " .. clip.title, {0.85, 0.8, 0.7})
  Wait.condition(function() MusicPlayer.play() end, function() return MusicPlayer.loaded end, 30,
    function() broadcastToAll("Audio chưa tải xong: " .. clip.title, {1, 0.5, 0.4}) end)
end

function stop() MusicPlayer.pause() end
function prevScenario() scen = scen > 1 and scen - 1 or #DATA[camp].scenarios; draw() end
function nextScenario() scen = scen < #DATA[camp].scenarios and scen + 1 or 1; draw() end
function prevCampaign() camp = camp > 1 and camp - 1 or #DATA; scen = 1; draw() end
function nextCampaign() camp = camp < #DATA and camp + 1 or 1; scen = 1; draw() end
